definition_of_done: A POST /sessions request with a valid, non‑empty feature_name returns 201 and a response containing a UUIDv4 session_id, status "open", a link matching "/sessions/{session_id}", and a canvas object with the four default quadrants.
The created session record is persisted in the Supabase `workspaces` table within 2 seconds of the request.
A POST /sessions request with a missing or empty feature_name returns 422 and does not create any session record.
The initial canvas state is emitted via Supabase Realtime and received by a subscribed NiceGUI client within 2000 ms of session creation.
regression_guardrails: The session link format remains exactly "/sessions/{session_id}" for all sessions.
Supabase schema for the `workspaces` table is unchanged except for the insertion of the new record.

scenarios.name: successful workspace creation
given: no existing session with feature name "Demo"
when: the client POSTs to /sessions with body {"feature_name": "Demo"}
then: the response body contains a session_id matching the UUIDv4 pattern
the response body contains link "/sessions/<session_id>" where <session_id> matches the session_id
the response body contains canvas.quadrants equal to ["IS", "IS NOT", "DOES", "DOES NOT"]
a record with that session_id exists in the Supabase workspaces table

scenarios.name: workspace creation fails with empty feature_name
when: the client POSTs to /sessions with that body
then: no new record appears in the Supabase workspaces table

scenarios.name: workspace creation latency under two seconds
given: a timer started immediately before the POST request
when: the client POSTs to /sessions with a valid feature_name
then: the elapsed time measured by the timer is less than 2 seconds

scenarios.name: realtime event emitted after creation
given: a NiceGUI client subscribed to Supabase Realtime channel for new session events
the client records the current time
when: the client POSTs to /sessions with a valid feature_name
then: the client receives a realtime event containing the initial canvas data within 2000 ms of the POST response
the event payload includes the same session_id returned in the HTTP response

scenarios.name: session link format unchanged
given: a session has been created successfully and its response link is recorded
then: the link matches the pattern "/sessions/{uuid}" where {uuid} is a valid UUIDv4

SPEC.context: Quadra needs an instant way for teams to start a collaborative decision‑making session. Users should be able to create a new workspace by providing a feature name and receive a unique link that opens a NiceGUI canvas showing four decision quadrants. The creation process must persist the session in Supabase and broadcast the initial canvas state to all connected clients within 2 seconds, without any authentication step.
api_contracts: POST /sessions (FastAPI route in quadra-app) – request body SessionCreateRequest { feature_name: string (non‑empty) }, no authentication, returns 201 with SessionCreateResponse { session_id: uuid, status: "open", link: "/sessions/{session_id}", canvas: { quadrants: ["IS", "IS NOT", "DOES", "DOES NOT"] } } or 422 on validation error.
dependencies: Supabase (PostgreSQL + Realtime) accessed via supabase-py (environment variables SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_KEY)
constraints: Session creation latency must be < 2 seconds (STRAT‑0001 goal)
feature_name must be a non‑empty string

decisions.text: We will generate session_id as a random UUIDv4 for every new session.
We will require feature_name to be a non‑empty string in the session creation request.

architecture_change.summary: Add core system, NiceGUI FastAPI container, session service component, and Supabase external system to support workspace/session creation.

added.does_not_own: User authentication (link‑based access only); Document management beyond quadrant data

added.does_not_own: Serving UI pages (handled by NiceGUI); Realtime push (handled by NiceGUI websocket layer)

added.owns: Persisting workspace (session) data; Emitting realtime change events to subscribed clients

Persists session and canvas records; subscribes to Supabase Realtime for change events
Websocket layer receives Realtime events from Supabase and pushes them to connected NiceGUI clients

sections.Architectural Style: Event‑driven, layered architecture. The outer layer is a FastAPI/NiceGUI container exposing HTTP endpoints and a websocket channel. Business logic lives in the Session Service component, which interacts with an external Supabase system that offers both durable storage and realtime change notifications. The design favours low‑latency event propagation over polling, aligning with STRAT‑0001's rejection of polling‑based synchronization.
sections.System Mission: Quadra provides an instantly‑available, collaborative workspace where teams can create a session (identified by a unique link) and edit four decision quadrants in real time. The system must create a session, persist its initial state, and broadcast updates within 2 seconds, enabling seamless synchronous decision‑making without authentication overhead.

SPEC.What is the concrete feature name to use: Workspace and Realtime Canvas Initialization (Intent 1 of quadra_intents.md). Intents 2 to 4 (card operations, session closure and agent retrieval, Markdown export) are out of scope for this spec.
SPEC.Which C4 element IDs are directly impact: quadra-app: the NiceGUI app container (UI served on FastAPI). session-service: the Python module that creates the session and its canvas in Supabase. supabase: external system, Supabase PostgreSQL plus Realtime.
SPEC.What is the exact API contract for creat: POST /sessions, a FastAPI route inside the NiceGUI app; there is no page for creating sessions. Request body: {"feature_name": "<non-empty string>"}. No authentication: access is link-based. Success: 201 with {"session_id": "<uuid>", "status": "open", "link": "/sessions/{session_id}", "canvas": {"quadrants": ["IS", "IS NOT", "DOES", "DOES NOT"]}}. A missing or empty feature_name returns 422 and creates nothing. The link opens the NiceGUI page /sessions/{session_id}, which shows the canvas and receives Realtime updates; an unknown session_id shows "Session not found". The agent harness endpoint belongs to Intent 3 and is out of scope.
SPEC.What are the names and locations (file p: src/quadra/sessions.py: create_session(feature_name) -> Session and a Session dataclass (session_id, feature_name, status, created_at, quadrants). src/quadra/api.py: Pydantic models SessionCreateRequest and SessionCreateResponse and the POST /sessions route. src/quadra/app.py: the NiceGUI canvas page. No separate JSON schema files: FastAPI generates the OpenAPI schema from the Pydantic models. Supabase tables workspaces (session_id, feature_name, status, created_at), canvases and quadrants, defined in supabase/migrations/0001_workspace.sql.
SPEC.Does this feature depend on any external: Supabase (PostgreSQL and Realtime) through supabase-py, configured with SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_KEY read from the environment. The UI framework is NiceGUI. Nothing else.
SPEC.Are there any specific constraints that: Session creation completes in under 2 seconds (STRAT-0001 goal). session_id is a random UUIDv4, since the link is the only access control. feature_name must be non-empty. When a session is created or modified, the Supabase Realtime event is pushed to every connected client through NiceGUI's websocket within the < 2000ms target of STRAT-0001, with no polling (polling is STRAT-0001's rejected alternative). No rate limiting and no idempotency handling.
SPEC.Are there any existing behaviors or syst: None: greenfield project. The repository only contains an empty src/quadra package.
